title: Rav Nachman bar Rav Zavda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.25b.3), Abaye speaks to Rava. Rava cites Rav Nachman bar Rav Zavda, or, in the alternative wording, Rav Nachman bar Rava. In both readings the source of the teaching is Rav. Hyman reports the reading Rav Chanin bar Rav Chisda from Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rava gives the teaching in his reply to Abaye in the linked passage. Hyman’s brief account mentions Abaye addressing Rava and then gives the attribution.

The linked passage names two alternative transmitters of Rav’s teaching. Hyman’s heading has Rav Zavda, while the supplied body abbreviates the title before Zavda as ר׳. The third name is Hyman’s reported variant from Dikdukei Soferim.
